import subprocess
files=[
"README.md","ROADMAP.md","package.json","src/do_again/cli.py","src/do_again/core/agent.py","src/do_again/core/schema.py","src/do_again/default_policy.json","src/do_again/service/runtime.py","templates/policy.json","tests/test_agent_claims.py","tests/test_cli.py","tests/test_executor.py","tests/test_service.py"
]
subprocess.run(["git","add",*files],check=True)
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--cached","--check"],check=True)
status=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--cached","--quiet"])
if status.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git","commit","-m","Harden control plane and simplify onboarding"],check=True)
subprocess.run(["git","push","origin","main"],check=True)
print(subprocess.run(["git","status","--short","--branch"],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout)
